The brand name 'Amazon Kindle' is visible on the bottom left bezel. The background is dark and out of focus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Below screen: physical QWERTY keyboard (miniature keys) or navigation pad with directional buttons.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a distinct section below the screen containing physical buttons/keys, consistent with the checkpoint description.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model (Kindle) and verify it aligns with the 'hand-held computer' taxonomy despite being an e-reader.
To verify the legibility and correctness of the 'Amazon Kindle' logo and the text on the screen, checking for AI gibberish.
To ensure clean boundaries between the fingers and the device casing, checking for melting or fusion artifacts common in hand-object interactions.
To assess lighting consistency and texture realism of the skin and plastic casing.

focus_areas: Text legibility on screen and bezel
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the screen. AI often generates plausible-looking but nonsensical text blocks. Verify if the text lines are straight and consistent. Also, check the thumbs pressing the device; ensure there is no unnatural warping of the skin or the device casing at the contact points.
